moments.title: Sam Fender's historic chart run
moments.blurb: Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' recently broke a 73-year record, becoming the longest-running UK number one single of all time with 19 non-consecutive weeks at the top.

source.l: Official Charts Company / Celeb Baby Laundry

angles.name: Record Breaker
angles.copy: Still talking about Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' making history! 19 weeks at Number 1 – a 73-year record broken. Incredible!
